name: Luna Luna Lunatic
original_name: ルナルナルナティック
source:
Luna, a highschool student, has loved his childhood friend Youta for a long time. He dresses and acts like a girl in hopes of becoming his girlfriend, and to prevent women from approaching him.

Recently, Youta has changed highschools for a boys' academy and Luna enrolls in the same school to pursue his love.

But at the new school, Youta gets acquainted with a delinquent student, Sei. And this new character begins driving a wedge between Luna and his romantic interest...

[From [url=https://edsan-games.itch.io/lunatica]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中男生露娜，已经喜欢青梅竹马尤塔很久了。露娜总是作女孩打扮，举止也像女孩一样，盼望着成为尤塔的女朋友，也想阻止其他女生接近他。

最近，尤塔转入了一所男子学校，露娜也为了追求爱情，进入了同一所学校。

然而，在新学校里，尤塔认识了不良学生塞伊。这个新出现的人，开始让露娜与心上人之间产生裂痕……

[摘自[url=https://edsan-games.itch.io/lunatica]itch.io[/url]]
